foundations.rationale: Exclusive thread ownership keeps contributor work identifiable and preserves related changes within one PR.

copy.rationale: The default starting point and the explicit user exception are stated in plain instructions. Existing work remains on its intended branch.

interface.rationale: Only contributor coordination instructions changed. Generator code, media and assets are outside this task.

bar-and-exports.rationale: Only contributor coordination instructions changed. Generator code, media and assets are outside this task.

media.rationale: Only contributor coordination instructions changed. Generator code, media and assets are outside this task.

assets-and-approvals.rationale: Only contributor coordination instructions changed. Generator code, media and assets are outside this task.

governance.rationale: The canonical policy and setup guides require fetching origin main before new independent work, using refreshed origin/main by default, and honoring explicit branch or revision choices. Existing worktree changes are preserved. Source and review requirements remain in place.

existingConflicts.disposition: Recorded in references/brand_conflicts.md. These instructions introduce no new use of the disputed treatments.

approvalRationale: Worktree and task-note guidance introduces no institutional artwork, media, assets or generator output.
publicationScope: Follow-up to owner-authorized thread-isolation instructions, making the fresh-main default and explicit base exception clear.

checks.name: brand-policy
checks.evidence: The guard validates source archive integrity, applicable source coverage and the changed-file fingerprint.

checks.name: unit-tests
checks.evidence: All 1,280 Jest tests across 106 suites passed against current main, using the existing locked test dependency installation read-only. The cached npm CLI has a missing module, so Jest and the brand guard ran directly. CI will verify the normal npm entry point.

checks.name: coordination-notes
checks.evidence: Verified the follow-up branch starts at the freshly fetched origin/main revision. Internal procedure links and diff formatting passed. The explicit branch/revision exception appears in policy and setup guidance.

checks.name: rendered-ui
checks.evidence: No app interface or runtime changes.

checks.name: user acceptance
checks.evidence: Contributor documentation has no generator visual acceptance requirement. The owner requested publication and merge.

checks.name: cross-client enforcement
checks.evidence: Other clients were not launched. These are cooperative instructions, not a process lock or live-chat detector.
